sections.heading: Why AI UGC is the Future of Ecommerce Ads
sections.body: Traditional UGC requires shipping products, waiting weeks for content, and high costs. AI UGC allows you to generate authentic visuals in minutes. By using specialized AI models like Perfect Mockup, you can maintain total control over both the product appearance and the creator's vibe, ensuring your ads align perfectly with your brand identity.

sections.heading: Step 1: Uploading Your Reference Product
sections.body: The foundation of a great AI UGC shot is a high-quality product photo. Upload a clean shot of your product. Our system will analyze the dimensions and labels to ensure every generation preserves your brand's integrity. No need for professional lighting at this stage—the AI handles the environment.

sections.heading: Step 2: Selecting the Right UGC Mode
sections.body: Navigate to the 'Lifestyle' tab and select 'UGC Mode'. This mode is specifically calibrated to produce 'imperfect' and authentic-looking photos. Unlike studio mode, UGC mode adds subtle noise, natural lighting variations, and realistic human interactions that thrive on platforms like TikTok and Instagram.

sections.heading: Step 3: Defining the Creator and Scene
sections.body: Choose your creator persona. Do you need a 'Gen-Z skincare enthusiast' or a '30-something kitchen pro'? Select the setting—a bedroom, a park, or a minimalist office. These choices define the narrative your customers will connect with.
